name: breeze-server-v3-docs
description: Builds the Breeze .NET server docs: the guide with VitePress, as the client docs are built, and the .NET API reference with DocFX. See DOCS.md.

scripts.docs:dev: npm run docs:api && vitepress dev docs
scripts.docs:build: npm run docs:api && vitepress build docs && node scripts/merge-api-docs.mjs && node scripts/check-doc-anchors.mjs
